'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Arab–Israeli conflict]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
****Eleven [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli soldiers]] are killed and several others are wounded when hit by an [[anti-tank guided missile]] in northern [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. Seven of those killed were from the [[Givati Brigade]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/nov/01/fifteen-israeli-soldiers-killed-as-fighting-intensifies-in-gaza (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-announces-another-9-soldiers-killed-fighting-in-northern-gaza/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[Jabalia refugee camp airstrikes]]
****[[31 October 2023 Jabalia refugee camp airstrike]]
*****More than 50 people are killed and 150 others are injured by [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] [[airstrike]]s at the [[Jabalia refugee camp]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. Reports indicate that the camp has been completely destroyed. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/hamas-says-it-fires-israeli-troops-pressing-gaza-ground-assault-2023-10-31/ (Reuters)]
***[[Amnesty International]] says that they have found that "the [[Israeli Army]] indiscriminately, and therefore unlawfully, used [[White phosphorus munitions|white phosphorous]] in an attack on Dhayra, in south [[Lebanon]] which "must be investigated as a [[war crime]]". [https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2023/10/lebanon-evidence-of-israels-unlawful-use-of-white-phosphorus-in-southern-lebanon-as-cross-border-hostilities-escalate/ (Amnesty International)] 
***Fifty-seven medical facilities have been damaged, with 32 currently inoperable due to ongoing airstrikes or lack of fuel, as Israel continue to target hospitals and medical centers. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/31/israel-hamas-war-live-israeli-air-attacks-continue-across-gaza (Al Jazeera)] 
***The [[Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights]] says that an immediate [[humanitarian]] [[ceasefire]] in Gaza is "absolutely imperative". [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/immediate-humanitarian-cease-fire-absolutely-imperative-in-gaza-un-human-rights-office/3038964 (Anadolu Agency)]
***The [[Greek Orthodox Patriarchate of Jerusalem|Patriarchate of Jerusalem]] blames Israel for the bombing of its cultural centre in [[Gaza City]], saying that the attack "represents a stark embodiment of Israel's unwarranted determination to destroy the civil infrastructure and social service centres, as well as shelters for civilians". [https://english.ahram.org.eg/News/511297.aspx (''Al-Ahram'')]
***The [[World Health Organization]] warns that Gaza is on the verge of a "[[public health]] catastrophe" due to overcrowding, widespread displacement, and severe damage to water and sanitation facilities, with only five percent of the normal [[water supplies]] accessible. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/31/israel-hamas-war-live-israeli-air-attacks-continue-across-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
***[[UNICEF]] says that at least 940 children have been reported missing in Gaza. They also state that infant [[dehydration]] is a growing threat, with Gaza becoming "a graveyard of children". [https://www.timesnownews.com/world/gaza-turned-into-a-graveyard-for-children-says-unicef-article-104856896 (Times Now)]
***UNICEF executive director [[Catherine M. Russell|Catherine Russell]] says that more than 420 children are being killed or injured in Gaza every day. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/31/gaza-has-become-a-graveyard-for-thousands-of-children-un (Al Jazeera)]
***The Palestine [[Red Crescent Society]] reports continuous [[artillery]] and airstrikes near the [[al-Quds Hospital]] in northern Gaza. The hospital currently shelters hundreds of patients and more than 12,000 [[Forced displacement|displaced]] [[civilian]]s. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/31/israel-hamas-war-live-israeli-air-attacks-continue-across-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
***The Palestinian Health Ministry says that 8,525 Palestinians, including 3,542 children, have been killed in Israeli air raids. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/gaza-s-death-toll-from-israeli-attacks-soars-to-8-525/3038831 (Anadolu Agency)]
***The [[UNRWA|UN agency for Palestinian refugees]] says that 64 of its employees have been killed during the war. [https://www.voanews.com/a/unrwa-chief-gaza-cease-fire-matter-of-life-and-death-for-millions-/7333962.html (VOA)]
***The Palestinian Prisoners Society says that Israeli forces arrested 60 Palestinians in the [[West Bank]], adding that the "arrests are accompanied with [[torture]] and abusive attacks, as well as [[collective punishment]] and destruction of property". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/31/israel-hamas-war-live-israeli-air-attacks-continue-across-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
***The death toll in the West Bank increases to 130 as five more Palestinians are killed by Israeli soldiers. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/1/dozens-killed-arrested-in-overnight-raids-on-west-bank-and-gaza?traffic_source=Connatix (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Iran–Israel proxy conflict]] 
**[[Israel]] intercepts three [[surface-to-surface missile]]s launched from [[Yemen]], with at least one missile being shot down by its [[Arrow (missile family)|Arrow missile defence system]]. The [[Iran]]-backed [[Houthi movement|Houthis]] claim responsibility for the launches. [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/syz6wu0ga (Reuters via Ynet News)]
*[[Mali War]]
**[[Tuaregs|Tuareg]] rebels from [[Permanent Strategic Framework for Peace, Security, and Development|Platform]] claim control over a camp in [[Kidal]], northern [[Mali]], following the evacuation of [[MINUSMA]] troops. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20231031-mali-rebels-claim-takeover-of-vacated-un-base-near-strategic-town-of-kidal (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Crimea attacks (2022–present)|Crimea attacks]]
***[[Ukraine]] launches [[airstrike]]s on [[Crimea]], destroying a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[S-300 missile system]] near [[Yevpatoria]]. [https://www.kyivpost.com/post/23508 (''The Kyiv Post'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Foreign relations of Bolivia]]
***[[Bolivia]] suspends diplomatic relations with [[Israel]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/bolivia-severs-diplomatic-ties-with-israel-citing-crimes-against-humanity-2023-10-31/ (Reuters)]
**The Governments of [[Chile]] and [[Colombia]] recall their respective ambassadors to Israel as a response to Israel's military actions in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/bolivia-severs-diplomatic-ties-israel-104524467 (''ABC News'')] 
**[[Canada|Canadian]] [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Canada)|Foreign Affairs Minister]] [[Mélanie Joly]] calls for a "temporary pause in hostilities" in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]], saying that "the humanitarian situation facing the Palestinian people, facing Palestinian women and children, is dire". [https://nationalpost.com/news/world/israel-middle-east/joly-pleads-for-temporary-pause-in-hostilities-so-humanitarian-aid-can-reach-gaza (''National Post'')]
**[[Australia]]n [[Minister for Foreign Affairs (Australia)|Foreign Affairs Minister]] [[Penny Wong]] expresses concern over growing attacks by residents of settlements on Palestinians in the occupied [[West Bank]], saying that "such violence threatens to only inflame tensions and those responsible must be held accountable". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/31/israel-hamas-war-live-israeli-air-attacks-continue-across-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Jordan]]ian [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Jordan)|Foreign Affairs Minister]] [[Ayman Safadi]] calls for an immediate stop to the "humanitarian catastrophe" in Gaza caused by Israeli bombardment and the implementation of [[international law]], while stressing the necessity of humanitarian aid. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/31/israel-hamas-war-live-israeli-air-attacks-continue-across-gaza (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2019 Whakaari / White Island eruption]]
**The [[District Court of New Zealand]] in [[Auckland]] finds [[Whakaari / White Island|Whakaari]]'s management guilty of insufficiently protecting visitors during the [[volcanic eruption]] that resulted in 22 deaths and 25 severe injuries. [https://www.voanews.com/a/company-guilty-over-new-zealand-volcano-disaster/7334082.html (AFP via VOA)]
*[[2022–2023 Bangladesh protests]]
**Two people are killed and dozens are injured in anti-government protests in [[Dhaka]], [[Bangladesh]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-67273559 (BBC News)]
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**Hundreds of demonstrators gather in front of the [[Embassy of Israel, Manila|Israeli embassy]] in [[Metro Manila|Manila]], [[Philippines]], to denounce the Israeli attacks on the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/31/filipino-protesters-slam-govt-abstention-on-israel-gaza-resolution-at-un (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Anti-war movement|Anti-war]] protesters interrupt a [[United States Senate|U.S. Senate]] [[United States Senate Committee on Appropriations|Senate Appropriations Committee]] hearing by [[United States Secretary of State|U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Antony Blinken]]. Protesters are removed by police. [https://thehill.com/policy/defense/4285214-anti-war-protestors-repeatedly-interrupt-senate-hearing-on-israel/amp/ (''The Hill'')]
*A man in his 70s is arrested in [[Seoul]], [[South Korea]], after stabbing and injuring two police officers in front of the [[Presidential Residence of South Korea|presidential residence]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/south-korea-detains-man-after-2-police-officers-stabbed-outside-presidential-2023-10-31/ (Reuters)]
*At least 380 people are arrested across [[Puerto Rico]] during a crackdown against 12 gangs dedicated to the sales of drugs and weapons. [https://apnews.com/article/puerto-rico-police-crime-operation-c17ed7650055c65bbb1026fffe2b868b (AP)]
*An explosion occurs at a military base near the [[agrotown (Belarus)|agrotown]] of [[Kalodziščy]] in central [[Belarus]]. The [[Ministry of Defence (Belarus)|Ministry of Defence]] claims that the explosion was deliberately orchestrated. [https://euroradio.fm/minabarony-belarusi-patlumachyla-vybukhi-pad-minskam (Euroradio)]
*At her 18 birthday, [[Leonor, Princess of Asturias]] swears the [[Constitution of Spain]] at the [[Cortes Generales]], formally assuming her title and role of heir to the Spanish throne. [https://apnews.com/article/spain-princess-leonor-oath-queen-18-royal-8aca7a3a310640028c4b79159341e982 (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Football Australia]] formally end their bid to host the [[2034 FIFA World Cup]], leaving [[Saudi Arabia]] as the only confirmed bid before [[FIFA]]'s deadline for declarations of interest expires. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/67271423 (BBC Sport)]
